name: HeroIcons v1 Solid
about: HeroIcons v1 Solid is a free, open-source icon set with 389 icons designed by Refactoring UI Inc. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.q: Are HeroIcons v1 Solid free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 389 HeroIcons v1 Solid are open source under the MIT license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the MIT terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use HeroIcons v1 Solid in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many HeroIcons v1 Solid are there?
faqs.a: There are 389 icons in the HeroIcons v1 Solid set, designed by Refactoring UI Inc. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of HeroIcons v1 Solid?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are HeroIcons v1 Solid available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
